course.title: Unit 6 Rain or Shine【例句】
course.description: Section B How do we feel about the weather?

sentences.content: What do you think you can see, hear, or feel when you climb a mountain?
sentences.english: What do you think you can see , hear , or feel when you climb a mountain ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为当你攀登一座山时，能看到、听到或感受到什么？

sentences.content: We’re at a rest area now.
sentences.english: We're at a rest area now
sentences.chinese: 我们现在在一个休息区。

sentences.content: Climbing is hard, but we’re making good progress.
sentences.english: Climbing is hard , but we're making good progress
sentences.chinese: 攀登很艰难，但我们进展顺利。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: Although the weather is bad, many people here are still in high spirits.
sentences.english: Although the weather is bad , many people here are still in high spirits
sentences.chinese: 尽管天气恶劣，这里的许多人仍然兴致高昂。

sentences.content: I don’t think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much, so I’m encouraging him.
sentences.english: I don't think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much , so I'm encouraging him
sentences.chinese: 我觉得我弟弟Peter不太享受这次体验，所以我在鼓励他。

sentences.content: We’re here at Mount Huangshan!
sentences.english: We're here at Mount Huangshan !
sentences.chinese: 我们现在在黄山！

sentences.content: The clouds look amazing.
sentences.english: The clouds look amazing
sentences.chinese: 云彩看起来美极了。

sentences.content: It feels like a magical place.
sentences.english: It feels like a magical place
sentences.chinese: 这地方宛如仙境。

wordDetails.definition: feel（第三人称单数）: 感觉

sentences.content: The trees and rocks look like a part of a painting.
sentences.english: The trees and rocks look like a part of a painting
sentences.chinese: 树木与岩石宛如画中景致。

sentences.content: The sun is shining through the clouds!
sentences.english: The sun is shining through the clouds !
sentences.chinese: 阳光正穿透云层！

sentences.content: It’s a lovely sight.
sentences.english: It's a lovely sight
sentences.chinese: 这真是一道美丽的风景。

sentences.content: I’m so glad we’re here at Bright Peak.
sentences.english: I'm so glad we're here at Bright Peak
sentences.chinese: 真高兴我们来到Bright Peak了。

sentences.content: Climbing is tiring!
sentences.english: Climbing is tiring !
sentences.chinese: 攀岩真累人！

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: My shoes are all wet and dirty too.
sentences.english: My shoes are all wet and dirty too
sentences.chinese: 我的鞋子不仅湿透了，还脏兮兮的。

sentences.content: There are many other tourists at this rest area, but they don’t seem tired at all.
sentences.english: There are many other tourists at this rest area , but they don't seem tired at all
sentences.chinese: 这个休息区还有许多其他游客，但他们看起来一点也不累。

sentences.content: Instead, they’re talking and laughing!
sentences.english: Instead , they're talking and laughing !
sentences.chinese: 相反，他们正在谈笑风生！

sentences.content: My sister Helen is also in high spirits.
sentences.english: My sister Helen is also in high spirits
sentences.chinese: 我的妹妹Helen也兴致高昂。

sentences.content: Today I’m visiting Mount Huangshan with my family.
sentences.english: Today I'm visiting Mount Huangshan with my family
sentences.chinese: 今天我和家人一起游览黄山。

sentences.content: I’m not really enjoying the experience.
sentences.english: I'm not really enjoying the experience
sentences.chinese: 我其实并不享受这段经历。

sentences.content: Everything looks grey, and you can’t see much because of the heavy fog.
sentences.english: Everything looks grey , and you can't see much because of the heavy fog
sentences.chinese: 一切都显得灰蒙蒙的，由于浓雾弥漫，能见度很低。

wordDetails.definition: look（第三人称单数）: 看起来

sentences.content: The ground is very wet, so we have to climb slowly.
sentences.english: The ground is very wet , so we have to climb slowly
sentences.chinese: 地面非常湿滑，因此我们不得不缓慢攀爬。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: We’re here at Bright Peak.
sentences.english: We're here at Bright Peak
sentences.chinese: 我们现在在Bright Peak。

sentences.content: Mount Huangshan is beautiful in the sunlight.
sentences.english: Mount Huangshan is beautiful in the sunlight
sentences.chinese: 阳光下的黄山很美。

sentences.content: I’m tired and hungry, but it feels good to be at the top!
sentences.english: I'm tired and hungry , but it feels good to be at the top !
sentences.chinese: 我又累又饿，但站在山顶的感觉真好！

sentences.content: There is a huge storm today.
sentences.english: There is a huge storm today
sentences.chinese: 今天有一场大风暴。

sentences.content: I am sitting in my room and looking out of the window.
sentences.english: I am sitting in my room and looking out of the window
sentences.chinese: 我正坐在房间里，望着窗外。

sentences.content: It is raining very hard.
sentences.english: It is raining very hard
sentences.chinese: 雨下得很大。

sentences.content: The rain is pouring down.
sentences.english: The rain is pouring down
sentences.chinese: 大雨倾盆而下。

sentences.content: The wind is blowing hard too.
sentences.english: The wind is blowing hard too
sentences.chinese: 风也刮得很猛。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 构成进行时

sentences.content: It is difficult for people to use their umbrellas.
sentences.english: It is difficult for people to use their umbrellas
sentences.chinese: 人们很难使用他们的雨伞。

sentences.content: A man in the street looks angry.
sentences.english: A man in the street looks angry
sentences.chinese: 街上的一个男人看起来很生气。

wordDetails.definition: look（第三人称单数）: 看起来

sentences.content: He is shouting and running after his hat!
sentences.english: He is shouting and running after his hat !
sentences.chinese: 他一边喊叫，一边追着他的帽子跑！
